At Tata Technologies, we make product development dreams a reality by designing, engineering, and validating the products of tomorrow for the world’s leading manufacturers. Due to our continued growth, we are now recruiting an Electrical Design Engineer to strengthen our engineering team.
Scope of Role
As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will be responsible for maintaining, updating, and validating electrical design documentation and calculations across multiple engineering platforms. The role ensures accuracy, consistency, and compliance with engineering standards across schematics, layouts, part lists, and system calculations. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to support electrical design integrity and system performance.
Main Responsibilities
Update and maintain electrical schematics and layouts, ensuring accurate location coding (EPLAN, AutoCAD).
Develop and modify electrical drawings according to project specifications.
Manage and validate electrical part lists, ensuring consistency and completeness of BOMs.
Extract and verify data generated from EPLAN outputs.
Perform and validate cable sizing and related calculations (El-vis tool).
Support energy consumption calculations and related documentation.
Maintain and update IP addressing within electrical documentation.
Perform and validate Performance Level (PL) calculations in line with safety standards (Sistema).
Develop and maintain electrical topology diagrams (Visio).
Ensure consistency of location codes across all tools and documentation platforms.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with system architecture and engineering requirements.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
4 to 6 years of experience in electrical design engineering.
Strong knowledge of electrical system design, industrial automation, and control panel engineering.
Experience in developing and maintaining electrical schematics, layouts, and topology documentation.
Good understanding of electrical safety standards, Performance Level (PL), and risk reduction principles.
Experience working in industrial, manufacturing, or automotive environments.
Ability to work independently and collaborate within cross-functional teams.

Tools & Skills
EPLAN – electrical schematics and part list generation
AutoCAD – electrical layouts
El-vis – cable calculations
Sistema – performance level calculations
Visio – topology documentation
Strong knowledge of location code management and data consistency across tools
Experience working with global teams and customer-specific standards
Proficiency in English, both written and spoken

Personal Qualities
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Detail-oriented with a structured approach to work
Effective communication and collaboration skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment
Proactive and self-driven mindset
Comfortable working in cross-functional and international teams

If you are passionate about bringing innovation to the projects you work on then we would love to hear from you.
Tata Technologies: Engineering a better world.
Tata Technologies would like to thank all applicants for their interest; each application will be reviewed against the set criteria for the role. We would like to advise that only candidates under consideration will be contacted. If you do not hear from us within 10 working days following the closing date it will mean that unfortunately your application has not been successful. We will however retain your details for any suitable future opportunities.

Join Midsummer as a Machine Operator at our production facility in Järfälla. You'll work with the manufacturing of our lightweight and flexible solar panels, supporting efficient production and consistent product quality.
This is a role for someone who enjoys practical work, takes pride in quality and is interested in technology and manufacturing. You'll work closely with your colleagues in production and contribute to stable processes and daily operations.
Please note that we are primarily recruiting for our evening shift.

What you'll be doing
As we rotate between different workstations and production steps, your tasks may vary over time. Depending on your workstation, the role may include:

Operating and monitoring automated and semi-automated production equipment

Setting up and running production machinery according to established procedures

Monitoring machine performance and identifying deviations

Performing basic troubleshooting and assisting with machine-related issues

Carrying out quality checks and documenting production results

Following work instructions, procedures and safety routines

Collaborating with colleagues to ensure an efficient production flow

Supporting continuous improvements within the production team

The role requires you to work both independently and as part of a team while taking ownership of your responsibilities following your training period.

What we're looking for
Experience working as a machine operator, production operator or in another manufacturing environment

A genuine interest in machinery, technology and manufacturing processes

The ability to understand and follow technical instructions, documentation and work procedures

Strong problem-solving skills and a structured, logical approach to troubleshooting

A quality-focused way of working and attention to detail

The ability to work both independently and collaboratively

Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Previous experience with machine maintenance, machine setup or troubleshooting is considered advantageous but is not required.
Technical, industrial or scientific education is also considered advantageous.

Who you are
You're reliable, responsible and quality conscious. You work in a structured manner, follow established procedures and take ownership of your work.
You have a safety-focused mindset and understand the importance of following routines and maintaining high quality standards. At the same time, you're a team player with good collaboration skills, adaptable to changing priorities and interested in technology and production.
Most importantly, you're motivated to learn, contribute and grow as part of the production team.

About Midsummer
Midsummer is a Swedish solar energy company that develops and manufactures lightweight, flexible solar panels at our production facilities in Järfälla, Sweden, and Bari, Italy. Our solar panels have a carbon footprint approximately 90% lower than traditional silicon-based solar panels, and we control the entire value chain from development to production.
Under the Midsummer Machinery brand, we also develop and supply production systems for flexible thin-film solar cells to customers around the world.
By joining Midsummer, you'll become part of a team contributing to the production of solar technology while working in an international and collaborative environment.

Interested?
We review applications continuously, so don't hesitate to submit your application.
We look forward to hearing from you!

Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.
Your role
As Proposal Manager, you will play a critical role in Saab's international Marketing & Sales activities. You will lead the proposal development process for complex international defence deals, ensuring high-quality submissions that meet customer requirements and position Saab competitively.

The role is focused on managing the end-to-end proposal process, coordinating inputs from technical, commercial and business teams.

You will work closely with Bid Managers, subject matter experts and stakeholders across Saab to deliver compelling proposals that showcase Saab's capabilities and value proposition.
Your responsibility spans four main areas:
Proposal Development - Lead the creation and assembly of competitive proposals, ensuring completeness, quality and consistency, ensuring that all contributors understand their responsibilities and deliver their input according to plan
Cross-functional Coordination - Coordinate inputs from technical, commercial, legal and financial teams to produce integrated proposals.
Quality Assurance - Ensure proposals meet customer requirements and follow Saab's standards for content, format and presentation.
Timeline Management - Manage proposal deliverables, ensuring that it is complete, compliant, professionally presented and submitted on time.
Your profile
We are looking for a structured and detail-oriented professional who thrives in a complex international business environment. You enjoy bringing people together and ensuring that proposals are delivered with the highest quality and on time.
To succeed in this role, we see that you:
Have experience of managing proposals, bids or complex business documents.
Have strong collaborative and communication skills.
Are comfortable working across organisational boundaries and engaging with a wide range of stakeholders.

Have excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
Have a "doer" mindset and take ownership from idea to execution.
Are fluent in English and Swedish.
Have curiosity and openness to technological development, with an interest in AI-based tools and methods.

Aspirational mindset with potential to grow into roles as Bid Manager, Bid Center Manager or other roles in sales.

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be a part of
Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring mission, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 26,100 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations. Read more about us here

Shape purchasing strategies and supplier partnerships for OT categories and machinery investments. In this position, you combine commercial responsibility with close collaboration across the organization to secure reliable, compliant and competitive solutions.

As Strategic Purchaser, you manage purchasing activities for assigned categories in line with procurement guidelines and KPIs. Your scope covers both strategic development and day-to-day purchasing, including regional and local agreements. 
 
Job responsibilities 
Develop category strategies together with Global Category Managers and relevant stakeholders. 
Lead sourcing activities, from identifying potential suppliers to negotiating agreements. 
Manage supplier performance across quality, cost and delivery. 
Maintain accurate purchasing information, contracts, prices and supplier data. 
Resolve supplier-related issues in collaboration with production, logistics, customers and finance. 
Contribute to supplier audits and continuous improvement of purchasing processes and tools. 

 
Location and flexibility  
The location for this position is Fagersta and we offer a hybrid solution.  
Your profile   
You understand strategic purchasing and know how to turn business needs into effective sourcing activities and supplier agreements. A structured approach helps you balance commercial objectives, compliance and collaboration across different functions. 
 
Your background includes 
Experience of strategic purchasing, sourcing or category management. 
Knowledge of supplier negotiations, contracts and performance management. 
Ability to analyze markets, prices, supplier capacity and historical purchasing data.

jobs.occupation: Business Development & Executive Search Consultant – Defence & Security
jobs.description:
Arbetsbeskrivning

JOB DESCRIPTION

Would you like to help build a growing executive search and specialist recruitment business in the Nordic defence and security sector?

In this role, you will develop client relationships, identify new business opportunities and lead recruitment assignments for organisations operating in a fast-growing and highly competitive industry. You will work closely with both clients and candidates, building a strong understanding of their needs and the people who can help move their organisations forward.

You will take ownership of your market and have the opportunity to shape your own position. This means staying close to the industry, learning continuously and taking an active role in conversations with companies and candidates across the Nordics and internationally.

The role combines business development with the delivery of high-quality search assignments. 

Din Profil

PROFILE

You are curious about the defence and security sector and genuinely motivated to understand the industry, its organisations and the people who work in it. Previous experience from the defence industry is not essential. What matters is that you are keen to learn, read up on the sector and enjoy building relationships with people who work in complex and important fields.

You are confident in client-facing situations and able to earn trust in a demanding environment. You take responsibility, put the client first and understand the importance of careful, professional relationship management with both clients and candidates. You are comfortable working internationally and collaborating across cultures.

We believe you will bring:

- Experience in a commercial, consulting, recruitment or other client-facing role
- Strong relationship-building and communication skills
- A genuine interest in people and in developing a deep understanding of the industries you serve
- A proactive, accountable and curious approach to your work
- The ability to communicate fluently in Swedish and English
- A valid B-category driving licence

We value sound judgement, maturity and personal drive. Your ability to build confidence, follow through and represent the business with professionalism matters as much as your years of experience.

Om företaget

ABOUT US

Defence Executive is being built as a Nordic executive search and specialist recruitment business focused on the defence and security sector. We are part of an established recruitment team with experience across several specialist industries, and we work closely together while each person develops their own market.

Our team has worked with some of the largest international defence groups, and we are a strategic partner. Joining us means helping to develop a growing Nordic platform with an established team and a recognised foundation in specialist recruitment. You will have room to be creative, build your own position and help shape how we work in the industry.

We are based in attractive offices on Drottninggatan in central Stockholm.

Kontaktuppgifter

CONTACT

Interested in helping build the next chapter of Defence Executive? Please submit your application and CV through the application form.

We look forward to hearing from people who are curious about the industry, passionate about building relationships and motivated to create long-term value for clients and candidates.

Do you bring senior leadership experience in enhancing business results through P&L ownership, operational excellence, and a focus on customers? If this sounds familiar and you are prepared for your next opportunity, then we look forward to hearing from you. 
 
Region NCE and Global Offshore > NCE > Service 
With nearly 7 GW of wind turbines covered by service agreements in Sweden and Norway, Vestas Service is the top provider of operations and maintenance services in the region. Supported by a team of more than 500 service technicians and professional staff, we are looking for our next leader to build on and further develop our leading position. Vestas Sweden & Norway is part of the newly established Nordic & Benelux Region, where collaboration across borders is key to delivering on our commitments to safety, employees, and customers.
 
Responsibilities
In this role, you will: 
Own regional service operations, ensuring contractual obligations are delivered safely, on time, and within budget
Lead our safety-first culture, continuously improving safety performance and reducing incidents across the business
Develop Operations and Customer Management teams, creating an organisation that pairs operational Excellence with deep customer engagement
Maintain full P&L accountability, acting with an owner's mindset and taking responsibility for business performance and results
Build strategic customer relationships and deliver consistently high levels of customer satisfaction
Help expand the business while keeping Service a central contributor to Vestas's long-term value and market position

 
Qualifications
We expect that you have: 
Degree in Engineering, Business, or related discipline
Significant leadership experience within wind energy, power generation, industrial services, or heavy engineering
Experience leading large operational teams across multiple locations
Solid commercial and financial acumen, including P&L responsibility
Demonstrated experience in customer-facing leadership roles
Solid understanding of HSE leadership and operational excellence
Effective communication and negotiation skills in English

 
Competencies 
In addition to the qualifications listed above, we are looking for someone who is:
An inspiring and visible leader who sets clear direction, builds engagement, and develops effective teams
Customer-focused and solution-oriented, with the ability to balance customer needs and business priorities
Structured, pragmatic, and execution-focused, translating strategy into measurable results
An effective communicator, capable of engaging effectively with employees, customers, and senior stakeholders

Collaborative by nature, building trusted partnerships across functions, regions, and global teams

 
What we offer
We offer the opportunity to manage the largest wind turbine service business in Sweden and Norway while serving in a key leadership role within Vestas NCE Service. In this role, you will be central to steering the business's direction, performance, and growth while leading a skilled team of professionals.

The position is in Malmö, Sweden. You can expect up to 40 days of travel per year for this role. If all the above matches your interests and qualifications, please apply before 30.11.2026.Please note: We amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including before the advertised closing date.

Ships come here from all over the world, mainly northern Europe, to take part in our first-class work, and you can become an important part of our project-based delivery. We offer a dynamic work environment with a focus on problem-solving and a high level of service. With us, you will be part of a dedicated team of approximately 110 employees, ranging from project management to production.
 
We are now looking for a Welder for our Pipe Department - a job for you who want to carry out repairs and maintenance work in the shipbuilding industry!
What does a Welder do with us?
In the role of welder, you belong to the Pipe department and are responsible for all manufacturing, repairs and maintenance of pipes and fittings, hydraulic equipment and much more!
We are looking for someone who has...

relevant upper secondary education (industrial programme with a specialisation in mechanics).

Experience with TIG/MIG/MAG

Experience from heavy industry

Knowledge of hydraulics is an advantage.

Good knowledge of English

B driving licence

As a person, you are positive and find it easy to collaborate with colleagues. You are driven, responsible and make sure that the job is done on time.
For those who want to develop and grow with us, there are great opportunities to take on greater responsibility in the long term, such as in the Pipe Department or in one of our other departments.
We offer

Please read more about us here: www.oddab.eu

by uploading your CV, or with your LinkedIn URL.

Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Hospitality Career?
Do you have experience in housekeeping and a passion for leading people? Are you looking for a workplace where your leadership skills are valued, your development is supported, and your efforts truly make a difference?
At OMNILS GROUP AB, we're not just cleaning hotel rooms, we're creating exceptional guest experiences. We are now looking for an energetic and motivated Housekeeping Team Leader to join our growing team in Stockholm Arlanda.
If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy inspiring others, and want to be part of a company with ambitious growth plans, we'd love to hear from you!
Why Join OMNILS GROUP?
OMNILS GROUP is one of Sweden's growing hospitality service providers, specializing in housekeeping and facility services for hotels and Real Estates
Approximately 200,000 hotel rooms are served annually
Around 200 employees across Sweden
ISO-certified in 14001& 9001
Collective agreement for secure employment conditions in Visita, Almega.
Pension and insurance according to collective agreements

 We believe our success comes from our people. That's why we invest in our employees' growth, well-being, and future.
Our Core Values
Commitment
Happiness

As a Housekeeping Team Leader, you will play a key role in ensuring operational excellence while inspiring and developing your team.

You will act as the bridge between hotel management, housekeeping staff, and OMNILS leadership while helping maintain exceptional quality and guest satisfaction.

Collaborate closely with hotel management and reception teams

We're looking for someone who is positive, reliable, flexible and motivated by helping others succeed.

At least 1-2 years of housekeeping experience within hotels
Previous experience leading or supervising a team
Strong communication and people skills
Excellent organization and problem-solving abilities
Detail-oriented with a passion for quality
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
Proficient in Swedish and/or English
Driving license is an advantage
Valid work permit in Sweden or Swedish citizenship

 
What We Offer
Career Growth
We believe in promoting from within. High-performing Team Leaders can develop into Supervisors, Operations Coordinators, Quality Controllers, and other leadership positions as the company grows.
Training & Development
Leadership training
Quality management training
Ongoing coaching and support

Apply Today

jobs.occupation: Key Account Manager - FMCG & Garden Centre
jobs.description:
Would you like to develop strategic retail partnerships in the Nordic gardening market and shape our next growth opportunities?
We are looking for a Key Account Manager, FMCG & Garden Centre, to join the Nordic Retail Sales team at Hasselfors Garden. You will take commercial ownership of strategically important FMCG and Garden Centre customers, with the opportunity to shape our growth agenda in Sweden and selected Nordic markets.
This role offers a combination of established strategic partnerships and new-business development. You will strengthen existing customer relationships while identifying new customers, exploring market opportunities and turning commercial insights into profitable growth. Working closely with Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Supply Chain and Operations, you will have a real opportunity to influence our customer offering, category performance and commercial priorities.
You will join a supportive Nordic sales organization where collaboration across commercial and operational functions is key. The role also offers opportunities for professional development within a leading Nordic growing-media and gardening company. Come and build the next chapter of our Nordic retail business with us!
What you do
Own and develop the FMCG & Garden Centre channels, translating market opportunities into customer and growth plans.
Manage strategic customer relationships, including annual plans, assortment, pricing, profitability, campaigns and commercial agreements.
Drive profitable growth through fact-based commercial decisions using sales, margin, ROI and customer data.
Build and convert a new-business pipeline in Sweden and selected Nordic markets.
Own customer forecasting and seasonal business planning.
Develop physical and digital category performance, including assortment, availability, visibility, placement and product content.
Bring customer, competitor and market insights into channel portfolio and product development, and actively participate in validating new concepts and commercial opportunities.
Work closely with Marketing, Customer Service, Product Management, Supply Chain and Operations to ensure successful customer execution.
Use CRM, analytics and digital tools to identify opportunities, prioritize actions and support commercial decision-making.

Preferred location: Central Sweden, around Örebro, or close to the Stockholm area. Regular travel is part of the role. The role reports to the Vice President, Sales Retail & Professional.
What we are looking for
You do not need to tick every box. We are looking for a commercially curious and proactive person who enjoys developing customers and business and is comfortable taking ownership.
Strong commercial retail and key-account experience.
Strong commercial understanding and interest in how sales, margin, assortment and customer investments create profitable growth.
Strong negotiation skills and the ability to build sustainable, long-term customer relationships.
A proactive, independent and collaborative way of working.
An analytical mindset and confidence in using CRM, forecasting and digital sales tools.
Interest in gardening products, retail categories or the consumer-goods environment.
Willingness to travel regularly within Sweden and, when relevant, other Nordic markets to meet customers and develop the business.
Fluent Swedish and English.

Contact Information
We cooperate with Consensus. For further information, please contact Lena Ahlin +46 70 374 34 94. We look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible, but latest by 15 November at www.consensus.nu (http://www.consensus.nu).

jobs.occupation: Senior Procurement Specialist – Technology & Supplier Management
jobs.description:
In this assignment, you will join the procurement organisation supporting Surveillance products, helping shape sourcing strategies for key suppliers and technologies. With commercial responsibility for selected strategic suppliers, you will develop agreements and sourcing solutions that support business objectives.
Working closely with project managers, product managers and contract owners, you will use supply market insights to align supplier capabilities with cost targets and technology roadmaps. You will also monitor supplier performance throughout the lifecycle and support the supply management organisation when issues require escalation.
The main purchasing categories are complex systems and computer products with advanced technical requirements.
Your responsibilities include:

Develop and execute strategic sourcing activities for the business area’s products.

Manage commercial relationships with strategic suppliers.

Negotiate and establish contracts that reflect business needs and commercial objectives.

Source materials and services.

Align sourcing plans with product, project and technology priorities.

Monitor supplier performance and support the resolution of escalated issues.

Build, manage and continuously improve supplier collaboration.

Your background
You enjoy working in a growing organisation where priorities evolve and you can contribute to change and improvement. You combine commercial judgement and customer focus with the ability to turn strategy into action.
You work well across functions, communicate clearly and contribute to a constructive team environment. You are also comfortable making considered decisions when information is incomplete.
The assignment involves domestic and international travel to company offices and suppliers.
Required experience and skills:

Extensive experience in strategic sourcing.

Ability to develop contracts that support the intended commercial outcome.

Relevant legal and commercial experience, together with an interest in contractual matters.

Experience building and managing productive supplier relationships.

Sound judgement and confidence in making decisions with incomplete information.

A committed, results-oriented approach and the ability to motivate others.

Previous experience in an industrial or technology-driven organisation.

Excellent written and spoken Swedish and English.

Preferred qualifications

A degree in engineering or equivalent education.

Experience sourcing products with advanced technical content.

Good understanding of supply chain processes and tools.

Security requirements
The assignment is subject to a security vetting process under applicable security protection regulations. Additional citizenship requirements may apply depending on the security classification of the position.
Application & Start Date
Start Date: ASAP
Assignment Duration: 12 months
Application Deadline: 2026-11-20
Location: Stockholm

jobs.occupation: AXIS OS Senior Software Engineer - Security, Lund
jobs.description:
We are growing our AXIS OS Security & Network team in Lund, Sweden, and seeking a talented Senior Software Engineer to join us. 
Your future team 
Our AXIS OS teams play an important part in the development of solutions within Axis software areas. Our embedded solutions are built to enable internal developers, partners and customers to make powerful software for secure streaming, analytics and advanced device management in an easy and efficient way. To develop innovative solutions, our teams experiment and collaborate with many other teams at Axis. We work in self-driven and autonomous teams with clear goals based on a strategic roadmap and prioritized backlogs. 
As security requirements continue to evolve, we work across AXIS OS to turn these requirements into practical, reliable solutions. You'll help strengthen AXIS OS security with current and emerging requirements, working closely with teams across the organization. 
To get to know more about AXIS OS and listen to some of our colleagues, check this out: Get to know the AXIS OS team. 
What You will do as Senior Software Developer - Security? 
You are involved in all steps from idea to solution. 
Your responsibilities and your main tasks will include: 
Developing end to end security features using an embedded environment, working in Linux User Space. 
Evaluating/reviewing, configuring, integrating and testing open source components. 
Designing, threat modelling, programming, reviewing, documenting and testing 
Sharing the knowledge and competence with other teams and colleagues 

Who You are 
You will thrive with us if you are curious, willing to learn and interested in solving things together with others. Your main focus will be working with security in a Linux-based environment. You are an experienced C-developer. 
You know your Linux with systemd and Dbus as tools in Linux User space. 
You are more than familiar with Public key infrastructure (PKI) and know how it works. 
You adopt and learn new technologies and tools to fit the need to what we develop. 
Ability to write and speak English fluently. 

In addition to the above we think you also have; 
A master's degree in computer science or equivalent experience 

What Axis has to offer 
We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security - developing solutions used worldwide.
As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.
Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration - whether through informal "fika" chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities.
Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle.

Life at Axis blog
Engineering at Axis blog
Innovation at Axis

About the role:
As a Lead Product Assurance Engineer – Space at APR Technologies you will own the Product Assurance and compliance framework for our space products and projects. You will provide independent oversight from design and supplier selection through manufacturing, qualification, acceptance and delivery, ensuring reliable, traceable and compliant flight hardware.

Key responsibilities:

Establish project Product Assurance plans, compliance matrices, deliverables and identify applicable standards.

Review specifications, drawings, manufacturing records, test plans, qualification evidence and End Item Data Packs.

Ensure that all Materials, Mechanical Parts and Processes (MMPP) are properly selected, controlled, qualified and approved

Lead supplier assurance, audits, inspection points and provide Product Assurance inputs to design, test and acceptance reviews.

Govern non-conformance reports (NCRs), deviations, waivers, root-cause investigations, MRB/NRB decisions and corrective actions.

Ensure configuration and change control, critical-item control, traceability and product conformity.

Monitor quality trends, systematic or safety-related defects, continuity risks and export-compliance evidence.

Who you are:
You are comfortable in a fast-moving technology company where priorities can shift and decisions are made quickly. Being structured and pragmatic, you drive your work forward with a solution-oriented mindset, collaborate well with others and share your knowledge with your colleagues. You act with integrity and sound judgment, pay close attention to evidence and detail, build quality into your work, and have the confidence to escalate when needed. 

Required qualifications:

Relevant technical BSc/MSc or equivalent engineering and quality experience.

At least five years in Product Assurance, Quality Assurance or technical compliance for high-reliability hardware.

Experience from working with Product Assurance in at least one space project.

Practical knowledge of relevant ECSS standards, plus ISO 9001.

Hands-on experience with audits, supplier quality, NCR/CAPA, configuration control and qualification or acceptance data.

Fluent professional English and confidence challenging technical decisions constructively.

Preferred qualifications:

Space-hardware experience and knowledge of ECSS-Q-ST-30, ECSS-Q-ST-40, ECSS-Q-ST-60 and ECSS-Q-ST-70.

Knowledge of EN 9100, ISO 14001 and/or ISO 27001

Experience with Thermal products, fluid systems, EEE components, materials and processes, or cleanroom operations.

Experience with warranty processes, systematic defects, business continuity, obsolescence and/or export-control processes.

Working at APR Technologies:
APR operates at the intersection of physics, engineering and one of the most pressing problems in technology: thermal management. The ambition is to become the global industry standard for thermal control, and we are well on our way.
Here your work is visible, your perspective counts and what you do has a real impact on where the company goes. Working here means solving problems that have real consequences for how technology develops and how much energy it consumes. It means being part of a team that takes both the technology and the business seriously.

About APR Technologies:
APR Technologies is a Swedish deep tech company developing and producing high-performance liquid cooling for applications in space, defense, batteries and chip cooling. Our core technology Rheion®, developed in collaboration with ESA and Airbus and protected by more than 70 granted patents in 22 countries, directs cooling liquid flow directly to the heat source with no moving parts.

About the role:
As a Senior Systems Engineer – Space at APR Technologies you will own the system architecture, technical baseline and verification strategy for thermal-management products for spacecraft, platforms, instruments and payloads. You will lead technical decisions and multidisciplinary integration from approved customer requirements through qualification and flight readiness.

Key responsibilities:

Develop product architectures for thermal products for spacecraft, satellite platforms, instruments or payload, ensuring optimal performance for the specific mission conditions.

Own the system architecture, requirements allocation, bidirectional traceability and controlled technical baseline.

Define and approve mechanical, thermal, fluidic, electrical and control interfaces.

Lead trade studies, technical budgets and design decisions across performance, mass, power, reliability and risk.

Define the verification and qualification strategy, including ICDs, DDVPs, VCDs and design justifications.

Chair technical reviews and lead integration, anomaly resolution, change-impact assessment and delta qualification.

Provide technical direction to design, analysis, test, Product Assurance and supplier teams.

Who you are:
You bring a systems perspective to your work and keep a disciplined eye on requirements and interfaces. You are decisive and analytical, and you can explain technical trade-offs clearly to engineers and non-engineers alike. You are pragmatic, work well with colleagues across disciplines, and are comfortable taking technical ownership. You are comfortable in a fast-moving, technical environment where priorities can shift and decisions get made quickly.

Required qualifications:

BSc or MSc in aerospace, systems, mechanical, electrical engineering, engineering physics or equivalent.

At least five years of systems-engineering experience in complex hardware, including direct involvement in a space project.

Experience of hands-on ownership of system architecture, requirements, interfaces and verification planning.

Working knowledge of relevant ECSS standards.

Fluency in professional English and strong technical documentation skills.

Preferred qualifications:

Experience of thermal control, pumped loops, fluid or pressure systems, electronics or spacecraft equipment.

Familiarity with spacecraft thermal control and two-phase heat transport.

Experience with environmental qualification and testing of flight hardware, including thermal-vacuum, vibration, EMC and/or radiation testing.

Hands-on experience with manufacturing, assembly, integration and testing (MAIT) of space hardware.

Working at APR Technologies:
APR operates at the intersection of physics, engineering and one of the most pressing problems in technology: thermal management. The ambition is to become the global industry standard for thermal control, and we are well on our way.
Here your work is visible, your perspective counts and what you do has a real impact on where the company goes. We are looking for a Network Infrastructure Manager for a consultancy assignment that will start as soon as possible and last 12 months in Solna.

The role ensures that site capacity, technical access, security, maintenance routines, vendor activities, inventory data and planned works are managed effectively to support customer delivery, network growth and stable operations.
The role acts as the local infrastructure escalation point and execution interface between Infrastructure Planning, Deployment & Construction, Operations, Service Delivery, vendors, site providers and other Network functions. It turns approved infrastructure plans into controlled site activities while keeping site records, cost inputs and capacity information accurate in the relevant company systems.
MAIN ACCOUNTABILITIES
Operational coordination and lifecycle execution for telecom sites and data center infrastructure in assigned countries.
Site capacity delivery for power, cooling, space, monitoring and technical site cabling inside the site environment.
Implementation coordination for site growth, end-of-life equipment replacement, telecom equipment installation and customer infrastructure installation.
Support OSP implementation.
Controlled access, site security execution and compliance with client’s defined site processes and local regulatory requirements within the role scope.
Maintenance governance, planned works coordination and local incident escalation for infrastructure-related site issues.
Vendor, contractor, site provider and engineering partner coordination for assigned countries and sites.
Infrastructure data quality, network inventory accuracy, documentation and reporting in relevant systems, inventory and reporting systems.
Cost, contract and forecasting support for infrastructure OPEX, CAPEX and service-related country inputs.
Support to bids, solution design, delivery, product development, service assurance and customer care processes with site infrastructure inputs.

ROLE REQUIREMENTS
Degree or equivalent solid knowledge in technical facilities, telecom infrastructure, data center operations, electrical systems, cooling systems or utility network operations.
Experience managing telecom sites, technical facilities, data center infrastructure, site operations, maintenance activities or infrastructure implementation projects.
Strong understanding of site power, cooling, space, technical cabling, monitoring, access control, maintenance routines and physical infrastructure lifecycle management.
Ability to coordinate vendors, contractors, site providers and internal stakeholders without direct line authority.
Good project management, planning, documentation and reporting skills, including structured follow-up from preparation through completion.
Comfortable working in a digital workspace, inventory systems, SharePoint, reporting tools and data platforms.

Autonomous in task delivery, collaborative as a team player and able to operate in a multinational environment.
